title: Automated HA with Patroni & repmgr
description: Deploy production-grade automated failover using Patroni, etcd, and HAProxy for true 99.999% database uptime.

data.text: **Patroni** is the industry-standard template for building high-availability PostgreSQL clusters. It coordinates node state via a Distributed Consensus Store (DCS) like **etcd** and automatically manages primary election, streaming replication, and failover.

data.caption: Patroni HA Cluster with etcd and HAProxy
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    Client[Application Client] --> HAProxy[HAProxy / Load Balancer]
    HAProxy -->|Port 5000: Write Pool| Primary[PostgreSQL Primary]
    HAProxy -->|Port 5001: Read Pool| Standby[PostgreSQL Standby]
    Primary <--> DCS[etcd 3-Node Cluster: Leader Election]
    Standby <--> DCS
    Primary -->|Streaming Replication| Standby

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Patroni uses etcd leader leases to ensure only one primary exists at any moment.
Healthcheck endpoints (`/primary`, `/replica`) allow HAProxy to route read/write traffic automatically.
The industry benchmark for self-hosted enterprise PostgreSQL high availability.
